name: Rapid onward movement after cash credits
description: Cash deposited is quickly withdrawn or transferred onward, including to another location or to unhosted wallets.
fp: Customers may use cash deposits for immediate bills.

links.name: Rapid cash-in then withdrawal to unhosted wallet
links.ctx: Fiat deposits are converted and sent to external wallets within minutes, leaving no balance.

links.name: Cash deposits followed by quick transfers to a handler in another city
links.ctx: Multiple low-value cash deposits by different people into one account, then rapid onward transfer or ATM withdrawal.
links.fp: Group business or family collections can resemble this.

links.name: Rapid withdrawals following deposits in different location
links.ctx: Funds credited in one area are withdrawn quickly elsewhere, often by ATM.

links.name: Rapid onward movement after cash credits
links.ctx: Funds credited in cash are quickly transferred out, withdrawn elsewhere or used for purchases leaving a low balance.
links.fp: Customers paying bills or suppliers on receipt of cash may do the same.
